# Battle of South Morava (1191)

* Peace For Both Sides Until 1195
| territory         = Recovery of Niš, Beograd (Belgrade), Northern Macedonia & Skopje
| combatant1        =  Byzantine Empire
| combatant2        =  Grand Principality of Serbia
| commander1        = Isaac II Angelos
| commander2        = Stefan Nemanja
| strength1         = Unknown (Likely Larger)
| strength2         = Unknown (Likely Smaller)
|casualties1 = Possibly Fewer Losses
|casualties2 = Possibly Heavy Losses
}}
The Battle of South Morava took place in the autumn of 1191, which resulted in a decisive Byzantine victory with Isaac II defeating Stefan Nemanja. A peace treaty would soon follow after Stefan was forced to cede Niš & some territory in the southwest of Serbia to Isaac.
